summary: The exact candidate is valid test-only hardening for an allocation/width correction already present on the recorded base. Its GPU regression passes on both candidate and base and the historical 614406-vs-614408 shape failure is independently reproduced. It does not modify runtime code or exercise the complete Blackwell TP=8 GLM EAGLE CUDA-graph path, so it must not be represented as a fully verified original-issue fix.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate d7771df9f850e6826771f552b4690a7a6b639ee2, the reported-width allocator/copy test and three independent width boundaries passed on GPU: 2 tests and 3 subtests.
The candidate test passed unchanged against recorded base 358c163, proving the runtime correction predates the candidate and the candidate is coverage-only.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-fc52938db4e1/venv/bin/python -c '<allocate historical (6,614406) destination and (6,614408) source, then copy>'
tests.what_was_measured: Independent GPU tensor-shape reproduction emitted the exact RuntimeError: size 614406 must match size 614408 at dimension 1. The dimensions were derived from the retrieved v0.5.14 allocator and reported target-verify shape.
No production DSA backend change exists between the recorded base and candidate.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X, gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015. Candidate/base regression copies and the historical shape mismatch executed on this GPU.
remaining_counterexamples: The regression does not invoke _apply_cuda_graph_metadata; a later defect in surrounding target-verify metadata generation could pass this allocator/copy fixture.
No NVIDIA sm100 CUDA graph was captured or replayed, so Blackwell-specific fused metadata behavior remains unverified.
No GLM-5.2-FP8 EAGLE serving request was driven to the 614400 context boundary.
No TP=8 run verified simultaneous worker behavior, process-tree shutdown, or Kubernetes restart semantics.
remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 ROCm GPU was available; the reported eight-Blackwell architecture was unavailable.
The historical failure was reproduced at the source-derived tensor-shape contract, not through the full v0.5.14 server stack.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was neither required nor performed.
